description: A 0.3 house with a winder stair: the step makes it declare "0.4" and changes nothing else - no record, no extras (20.7.1, 20.3.2). A reader of 0.4 reads both alike: it derives the stair's winders, walkline, goings and headroom for the 0.3 document as for its migration, and reports FS-LINT-018 for both, since the winders meet at a point (20.6.1).
